caption: In the app, Basic is $0 a month for 300 impressions and Pro is $4.99 for 3,000. The app counts impressions, while the listing speaks of e-mails and push notifications. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Pro: $4,99 every 30 days after a 7-day trial, plus usage charges up to $99 per 30 days. No usage rate is printed anywhere. We approved nothing. The store name is hidden.
Even the free Basic plan bills usage: you pay once you begin to use the app, up to $99 per 30 days, and Shopify asks for a payment method. No rate is shown. The store name is hidden.
Three abandoned cart push stages (30 minutes, 6 hours, 12 hours) are on by default. All counters sit at 0, and we saw no e-mail stage for carts. The store name is hidden.
The preview of the first cart push message. This is only the in-app preview: no shopper opted in and no message went out, so we saw no recovered cart. The store name is hidden.
